paper_title: A microwave paraphoton and axion detection experiment with 300 dB electromagnetic shielding at 3 GHz
notes: Microwave LSW (light shining through wall) experiment at CERN searching for paraphotons (hidden photons) via kinetic mixing chi. Quoted exclusion point: m_gamma' = 1.1e-5 eV/c^2, chi = 7.6e-9 at fsys=2.9565 GHz. This is the only explicit numerical exclusion point given in text; the full curve is shown only in Fig. 2 (not numerically extractable). Confidence level not explicitly stated; assumed 95%. | Vision: Microwave LSW exclusion at 2.9565 GHz (m_gamma' = 1.1e-5 eV). The exclusion region (cyan triangle) reaches its sensitivity tip near chi=7.6e-9 at the system frequency mass. Boundary traced for the cyan 'Microwave LSW March 2012 CERN' region. Y-axis is log10(chi), x-axis log10(m_gamma'[eV]). Points reflect the V-shaped sensitivity around the resonant frequency.
